register.labelZh: PRESS 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: press on、press ahead 和 press forward 可以描述某人即使遇上惡劣天氣、問題或延誤,仍然繼續前進。；press for 和 press somebody for something 可以用來談論強烈要求答案、會面、更安全的環境或更好的待遇。；press in on 可以描述人群逐漸靠近,也可以表示某人感到被牆壁、黑暗、憂慮或問題包圍。；press something on somebody 表示某人不斷給予食物、禮物、金錢或意見,並硬要另一個人接受。
register.summaryEn: Press on, press ahead and press forward help you describe someone who continues despite bad weather, problems, delays or other difficulties. Press for and press somebody for something help you describe strong requests for answers, meetings, safer conditions or better treatment. Press in on can describe a crowd moving closer or a person feeling surrounded by walls, darkness, worries or problems. Press something on somebody shows that a person keeps offering food, gifts, money or advice and strongly wants the other person to accept it.

fixedVariable.variableZh: press on、press ahead 和 press forward 本身已是完整表達。只有在要說明繼續進行哪項工作、計劃或活動時,才加上 with + 名詞。；press for something 表示強烈要求某事;press somebody for something 表示向某人追問或催促某人提供某事。；當某人硬要另一個人接受某物時,使用 press + 某物 + on + 某人。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Press on, press ahead and press forward are already complete expressions. Add with + a noun only when you want to name the work, plan or activity being continued. They pressed on. They pressed on with the work. Compare these two forms: They pressed for an answer. They pressed him for an answer. When someone strongly insists that another person accept something, use: press + something + on + somebody She pressed it on me.
